spec.name: Earnings drift v30
spec.notes: Rank names by the latest earnings surprise and hold through the drift.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 3.0, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 5%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is 3.38 against 2.99 in research, a gap of -0.39.
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 2.99 to 2.99. Strict mode changed no field or operator the signal uses.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 2.99 against 2.99 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 3.14 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.01, 95th percentile 0.53).

verdict.opinion: The strategy demonstrates robust performance across all validation metrics. The holdout test confirms the strategy's efficacy, showing a Sharpe ratio improvement in the sealed period. Point-in-time integrity is verified, and the strategy is immune to survivorship bias. Furthermore, the placebo test confirms that the signal's performance is statistically significant and not a result of random chance. With no damaging evidence found and all performance claims validated, the strategy is approved for full capital deployment.
